item.title: [github_trending] harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
item.description: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an open-source, one-stop AI short-video generation tool. After you enter a topic or keyword, it automatically writes the script, matches visual material, generates subtitles and background music, and renders an HD video. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux with Python 3.11+, and it's on the GitHub trending list—handy for creators who need to produce short-form video in bulk.

item.description: After switching from Cursor to Codex for over two weeks, the author found Codex closer to the next-generation AI programming form — not just a coding assistant but a true super agent capable of handling tasks independently. This hands-on comparison highlights a shift from code completion to autonomous agents, useful for developers evaluating AI coding tools.

item.title: [infoq] 从模型能力到工程优化，海外开发者正在“榨干” Qwen3.8-27B
item.description: Qwen3.8-27B is a natively multimodal 27B dense model open-sourced under Apache 2.0; quantized builds can run on consumer GPUs. It beats Claude Opus 4.6 Max on several coding, agentic, and multimodal benchmarks, and has drawn excitement from local-model enthusiasts as one of the most promising releases.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] DSH 插件-把回复第一行对齐到页面顶部
item.description: The DSH plugin dsh-reply-top-align aligns the first line of a long reply to the top of the page, fixing the default last-line alignment that forces users to scroll up to read from the beginning. The code is on GitHub at zisen123/dsh-reply-top-align, with installation steps in the repo's INSTALL.md.

item.title: [infoq] WorkSwarm：引领办公智能体新范式，让AI从一个助手，进化为一支与你并肩作战的团队
item.description: openJiuwen, built jointly by Huawei's 2012 Labs et al., has upgraded its swarm agents into WorkSwarm, now available on HarmonyOS PC app store with Windows and Mac support. Using Coordination Engineering, it organizes multiple agents to hand off tasks — e.g., 7 agents can co-create a song. It offers single-agent and swarm modes, letting users monitor progress or join the team.

item.title: [v2ex] [Claude] Claude Code 周限额明天开始就要减 1/3 了
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Code weekly limits promotion ends tomorrow; since May 13 it has raised limits by 50%, so after it ends users get roughly one-third less than during the promo. The 5-hour usage limit is unaffected. One user reports finding it hard to go back to Opus or GPT 5.6 after using Fable 5.

item.title: [infoq] 当 AI 遇见 FinOps：Snowflake 如何为 AI 时代重新定义成本管理 | 技术趋势
item.description: Snowflake is embedding AI into its FinOps tooling and offering governance primitives to manage unpredictable AI costs. Per the FinOps Foundation's State of FinOps 2026 report, 98% of teams now manage AI spend, up from 31% two years ago. Key pain points: visibility, allocation, and ROI.

item.description: Snowflake built Snowplan, an internal long-term planning app using Streamlit, replacing a giant Excel model. Analysts edit assumptions in the UI, which writes back to Snowflake and recomputes outputs instantly. It supports versioning, scenario comparison, and role-specific granularity.

item.title: [infoq] npm 正式上线分阶段发布功能，软件包上架前新增人工审核环节
item.description: npm has made staged publishing GA: package versions land in a staging queue and require maintainer approval (with 2FA) before becoming installable. Aimed at supply-chain attacks like the Shai-Hulud worm, it's designed to work alongside OIDC-based trusted publishing. Requires npm CLI >= 11.15.0 and Node >= 22.14.0.

The post shows installing Socket with `npm install -g socket`, then running DeepSeek Harness via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` so Socket guards the installation and execution. It's a practical reference for developers worried about supply-chain security in AI tools.

item.title: [v2ex] [程序员] 做了一个数据库管理软件 DBNova，刚刚发布了 beta.3
item.description: DBNova's beta.3 is a Wails-based database manager that supports multiple SQL databases as well as MongoDB and Redis on Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS Arm64. It extends SQL syntax and comments for parameterized reuse and can generate d.ts from database structures into Monaco Editor for TypeScript users. No features are paid yet; the author plans to add a paid single-database-window feature only after Wails3 ships.

item.title: [producthunt] Inferock Bench
item.description: Inferock Bench generates an independent receipt for each LLM API call, enabling verification that requests were handled correctly. It's useful for teams that need auditability and traceability in AI service usage.

item.title: [producthunt] Blume
item.description: Blume is a documentation framework that puts Markdown first and is explicitly described as AI-ready. It positions itself as a bridge between plain-Markdown docs and AI tooling, which may appeal to teams that want their documentation to be easily consumed by LLMs or retrieval pipelines. The Product Hunt listing provides no API or architecture details.

item.title: [v2ex] [股票] 行业地图产品种子用户
item.description: An investment-research product called 'Industry Graph' is recruiting seed users, offering permanent free Pro access and early access to new features. The developer wants direct feedback on bugs, real use cases, and feature requests, with the goal of visualizing industry-chain relationships for faster sector understanding and opportunity discovery. Suitable for stock researchers and industry analysts who want early access and direct input.

item.title: [hackernews] Israel creates fake think tank in likely attempt to dupe AI chatbots
item.description: A report claims the Hanover Institute published at least 100 articles in just over a week, with content seemingly tailor-made to sway AI chatbots, and describes it as a fake think tank created by Israel. It raises concerns about AI systems ingesting coordinated disinformation from indexed text. Worth reading for those focused on AI security and information warfare.

item.title: [producthunt] Expeditione
item.description: Expeditione is an interactive 3D encyclopedia listed on Product Hunt. Its one-line description says it presents encyclopedia content in a three-dimensional, interactive way, making it appealing to users who enjoy visual exploration and self-directed learning.

item.title: [producthunt] GLM-5.3
item.description: GLM-5.3 is listed on Product Hunt with the tagline 'Coding leap from scaled post-training on the same base,' suggesting major coding improvements from scaling post-training while keeping the base model unchanged. Developers and researchers tracking LLM coding progress may find it noteworthy.

item.title: [producthunt] Vidaya
item.description: Vidaya is a health product on Product Hunt that calculates a healthspan score from wearable device data, lab tests, and DNA. It's aimed at users interested in quantified self-tracking and longevity management.

item.title: [hackernews] Anthropic's ‘watermark’ text adulteration in Claude is a perversion of writing
item.description: In a Daring Fireball post, John Gruber criticizes Anthropic's plan to watermark all Claude output text via steganography to comply with an EU regulation, rather than using invisible Unicode. He notes the company's announcement gave no implementation details, and argues that leaving probabilistic fingerprints through token selection during inference perverts writing.

item.title: [hackernews] Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to overthinking things
item.description: Qwen 3.8 27B is a 27B-parameter vision-language model from Alibaba's Qwen lab, released under Apache 2.0. Simon Willison found it excellent but prone to overthinking by default; it runs as a 17GB Q4_K_M quantized build on a MacBook Pro and NVIDIA DGX Spark, with benchmarks beating both Qwen 3.6 27B and closed-weight Qwen 3.7-Plus.

item.title: [infoq] DeepSeek Harness 怎么入门？这套极简教程用一个项目给你讲清楚
item.description: Geek Time's teaching team has released an open-source hands-on tutorial for DeepSeek Harness, built around a sample project called Task Lens. It walks you from an empty directory through launching the harness, switching model providers, comparing agent presets, and configuring plugins, with seven short articles designed to be finished in one or two hours. Developers who want an end-to-end mental model before diving into the source code will find it useful.

item.title: [hackernews] Claude: System Prompts
item.description: This post links to the updated core system prompts for Claude, now available on claude.ai and the official iOS and Android apps. Developers who tune Claude or audit its behavior can read exactly what changed in the official prompts, making it a useful primary reference for understanding the model's guardrails and default instructions.

item.title: [zhihu] 官方调整住房公积金政策，租房提取公积金取消收入比例门槛，装修自住住房可提取公积金，哪些变化值得关注？
item.description: Based on the title, Chinese authorities adjusted housing provident fund rules: rental withdrawals no longer have an income-ratio threshold, and renovations to owner-occupied homes become eligible for withdrawal. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

item.title: [infoq] 模型跑起来之后：视觉 AI 还需要哪些系统能力？
item.description: Glint AI Studio, the new website from Chinese visual AI company Glint, productizes the system capabilities needed after model training: the GBOX edge-computing box handles edge inference, while MENTOR for training and EXPERT for operations can pair with GBOX to cover continuous training or fully local deployment. It shows that model accuracy alone isn't enough—deployment, scheduling, and data feedback are where real-world visual AI projects succeed or fail.

item.title: [github_trending] public-apis/public-apis
item.description: public-apis/public-apis is a GitHub repository maintaining a collective list of free APIs. Its README currently promotes APILayer's unified suite, pitching one account, one dashboard, and one API key to access production-grade REST APIs for geocoding, email validation, flight data, stock data, and search. Developers looking for free API collections can use it as a directory.

item.title: [hackernews] A Preview of DuckDB v2.0
item.description: DuckDB v2.0 is scheduled for this fall, according to an official preview. The headline features include running DuckDB as a server, triggers, the VARIANT type, asynchronous I/O, a new SQL parser, and a new storage format. Developers using DuckDB for embedded analytics or planning server-side deployments should pay close attention.

item.title: [infoq] Dario “破防小作文”超千万人围观！LeCun 开炮：信任危机是因为你搞权力集中
item.description: Anthropic co-founder and CEO Dario Amodei posted a long X thread on August 16 addressing the AI trust crisis, acknowledging that AI companies haven't delivered on their promises; it has surpassed 10 million views. He rejects the 'regulation equals power concentration' framing, argues institutional processes can decentralize power, and supports policies that slow frontier labs while benefiting smaller competitors, citing California's SB 53 and SB 1047.

item.title: [hackernews] How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots
item.description: Developer Tim Marinin noticed that Bluesky screenshots show a logo in the corner even though the app UI doesn't display one — the spot is occupied by a Follow button. When he screenshotted during an app-switcher transition, the button was still visible, so he suspects Bluesky hooks the iOS screenshot shortcut and swaps in the logo at the last moment. He published his investigation.

item.description: An open-source GitHub project, mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills, provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents across 29 security domains, mapped to six frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE F3. It follows the agentskills.io standard and is Apache 2.0-licensed. Developers building security-focused agents can use it as a ready-made skill library.

The release marks DeepSeek's official entry into the agent space, giving developers who want to try dsh a practical starting point and a useful reference for studying how the tool is built.

item.title: [github_trending] agalwood/Motrix
item.description: Motrix is a full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent and magnet links. Its v2 rewrite, Motrix Turbo, is built with Electron, React, and TypeScript and decouples the download core from the UI; browser extensions and CLI tools talk to it over MDXP, an open protocol based on JSON-RPC 2.0, with plugins running in sandboxes. Developers who want a cross-platform downloader or a clean Electron architecture example should find it useful.

It argues that you need to understand how AI works before using it well, and offers practical advice for integrating Codex into daily development.

item.title: [juejin] 如何设计一个优秀的 Skills

The article uses this lens to explain how to design better Skills. Useful for developers building AI skills.

It has been translated into 14 languages and is licensed under Apache-2.0 — a practical resource for developers who want to learn how AI agents are designed and built.

The repo also includes fast in-memory 'direct mode' tests with mocked web/LLM calls, end-to-end integration tests against GenLayer Studio, contract linting, and a GitHub Actions CI pipeline — a ready-made scaffold for GenLayer contract development.
